description: This file defines an abstract generator class for data loading and preprocessing in an object detection pipeline, specifically for use with Keras. It includes methods for loading images and annotations, applying transformations, resizing, batching, and generating anchor targets, tailored for training object detection models like RetinaNet.

classes.name: Generator
classes.description: An abstract base class for data generators used in object detection training pipelines, providing methods for data loading, augmentation, batching, and target generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the generator with configuration parameters, sets up data grouping, and shuffles groups if specified.

methods.name: on_epoch_end
methods.description: Shuffles the data groups at the end of each epoch if shuffling is enabled.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Abstract method to return the size of the dataset.

methods.name: num_classes
methods.description: Abstract method to return the number of classes.

methods.name: has_label
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a label is known.

methods.name: has_name
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a class name is known.

methods.name: name_to_label
methods.description: Abstract method to map class name to label.

methods.name: label_to_name
methods.description: Abstract method to map label to class name.

methods.name: image_aspect_ratio
methods.description: Abstract method to compute the aspect ratio of an image.

methods.name: image_path
methods.description: Abstract method to get the file path of an image.

methods.name: load_image
methods.description: Abstract method to load an image given its index.

methods.name: load_annotations
methods.description: Abstract method to load annotations for an image.

methods.name: load_annotations_group
methods.description: Loads annotations for a group of images, ensuring each annotation dict contains 'labels' and 'bboxes'.

methods.name: filter_annotations
methods.description: Filters out invalid bounding boxes outside image bounds or with negative width/height.

methods.name: load_image_group
methods.description: Loads a group of images based on their indices.

methods.name: random_visual_effect_group_entry
methods.description: Applies a random visual effect to an image and its annotations.

methods.name: random_visual_effect_group
methods.description: Applies visual effects to each image in a group.

methods.name: random_transform_group_entry
methods.description: Applies a random geometric transform to an image and its bounding boxes.

methods.name: random_transform_group
methods.description: Applies random transforms to all images in a group.

methods.name: resize_image
methods.description: Resizes an image according to min and max side constraints unless no_resize is True.

methods.name: preprocess_group_entry
methods.description: Preprocesses an image and its annotations, including resizing and normalization.

methods.name: preprocess_group
methods.description: Preprocesses a group of images and annotations.

methods.name: group_images
methods.description: Creates groups of image indices based on aspect ratio or random shuffling for batching.

methods.name: compute_inputs
methods.description: Constructs a batch tensor from a group of images, padding to the maximum shape.

methods.name: generate_anchors
methods.description: Generates anchor boxes for a given image shape based on configuration.

methods.name: compute_targets
methods.description: Computes training targets (e.g., anchor labels and regression targets) for a batch of images and annotations.

methods.name: compute_input_output
methods.description: Loads, filters, augments, preprocesses images and annotations, and computes network inputs and targets for a group.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the number of batches per epoch.

methods.name: __getitem__
methods.description: Generates a batch of data for training or validation given an index.
